topic: They find a baby bird that fell from its nest and get a grown-up to help put it back safely.

episode.title: Mishi & Bruno: A Little Bird Needs Help

shots.narration: Something tiny was peeping underneath the garden shrub!
shots.scene: Sunny garden, dense flowering shrub beside a low branching tree, vertical 9:16, warm 3D family animation, no text.
shots.action: Mishi parts the outer leaves, leaving the shrub's interior concealed.
shots.mood: Bright flowers framing a mysterious leafy opening.

shots.narration: A baby bird had fallen, hidden among the leaves.
shots.scene: Ground-level view beside the shrub, soft grass beneath dense overlapping leaves, bird entirely offscreen.
shots.action: Mishi crouches beside the shrub without reaching inside.
shots.mood: Mishi's wide green eyes and gently tilted ears show concern.

shots.narration: [surprised] Bruno wanted to scoop the little bird right up.
shots.scene: Grassy edge of the flowering shrub, leafy interior concealed, rounded colourful garden beyond.
shots.action: Bruno extends one paw toward the shrub.
shots.mood: Floppy ears lifted and brows raised with eager concern.

shots.narration: Mishi gently stopped him. They needed a grown-up.
shots.scene: Beside the dense garden shrub, warm sunlight on a clear patch of grass.
shots.action: Mishi rests her paw on Bruno's extended paw.
shots.mood: Gentle eye contact and relaxed paws.

shots.narration: Above them, its nest rested between two low branches.
shots.scene: Low tree fork above the shrub, small twig nest screened by leaves, no bird visible.
shots.action: Mishi points toward the leafy nest.
shots.mood: Sunlit branches connect the hidden ground spot to the nest.

shots.narration: [excited] Bruno hurried to fetch help from inside.
shots.scene: Short garden path leading to an open kitchen doorway, cosy colourful interior beyond, nobody else visible.
shots.action: Bruno trots toward the open doorway.
shots.mood: Purposeful little steps and bouncing floppy ears.

shots.narration: He called until a grown-up answered from inside.
shots.scene: Open kitchen doorway viewed from the garden, interior beyond the threshold concealed by the door angle.
shots.action: Bruno barks toward the unseen room.
shots.mood: Bruno stands tall with an earnest, open-mouthed expression.

shots.narration: Mishi waited nearby, giving the little bird plenty of space.
shots.scene: Wide garden view with Mishi several steps from the dense shrub, baby bird entirely concealed.
shots.mood: Still paws, soft eyes, and a generous clear space around the shrub.

shots.narration: [whispers] Together, they waited while the grown-up checked the bird.
shots.scene: Garden path facing away from the shrub, grown-up and bird entirely outside the frame.
shots.mood: Two patient friends with attentive ears and neatly tucked paws.

shots.narration: The grown-up safely returned the little bird to its nest.
shots.scene: View from behind the friends toward the low tree fork, nest interior fully screened by leaves, grown-up offscreen.
shots.action: Mishi tilts her face toward the nest.
shots.mood: Warm sunlight surrounds the sheltered nest and the friends' relaxed silhouettes.

shots.narration: Then, a familiar rattle came from their watering can.
shots.scene: Sunny garden path, rounded yellow watering can beside a flowerpot, leafy tree in the background.
shots.action: Bruno turns his head toward the watering can.
shots.mood: One floppy ear lifted beside the bright yellow can.

shots.narration: [excited] Ask grown-ups for help! Next, what's rattling in our watering can?
shots.scene: Close garden view of the yellow watering can between the two friends, vertical 9:16, no markings or text.
shots.action: Mishi leans toward the watering can's opening.
shots.mood: Curious green eyes, Bruno's playful head tilt, and warm golden light.

episode.endHook: What's rattling inside their watering can?
episode.description: A tiny peep leads Mishi and Bruno to a baby bird beneath a garden shrub. They keep their distance and ask a grown-up to help reunite it with its nest.
